title: Prototype

act2.summary: a field is added to the template

solutions.title: structuredClone over a small prototype registry
solutions.tradeoff: A new field on JobTemplate needs no change anywhere near the clone - structuredClone copies whatever fields the object has, by construction. The price: cloning is opaque. There is no line of code that says what gets copied, which means a field that should NOT be copied as-is (an identity, a resource handle) gets copied anyway, silently, exactly like every other field.

reviewFocus: Does cloneTemplate's solution-route body mention any single field of JobTemplate by name?
If JobTemplate grew a field holding something that should NOT be deep-copied (an open file handle, a database connection), would structuredClone even compile, let alone behave correctly?
Is the manual field-by-field version in src/ actually wrong today, or just one forgotten field away from wrong - and where does the regression test in tests/ draw that line?
Would a `clone()` method on JobTemplate itself, rather than a free function, better fit GoF's own Prototype interface - and what would that cost callers who just want a plain object?
